name: Natsu Kagura
source:
Main character is an apprentice who specializes in killing youkai. With the members of the shrine he hunts for youkai at night and trains during daytime.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名专门消灭妖怪的见习者。他白天修行，夜晚则与神社成员一同狩猎妖怪。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
